headline: Hawai'i Hilo alone unbeaten in a losing conference
dek: Hawai'i Hilo have won all three of their matches and conceded a single goal, with both of their meetings with fellow members among the wins. No other programme has won as often, and Vanguard have yet to take a point.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not bought results at the top of the chart: Dominican (Calif.) share the lead on six goals without a win, having conceded seven, and their scoring is spread across six different players.

wire.line: Vanguard have conceded eleven goals in three defeats, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fifteen matches dated before the end of August carry no published result, most of them preseason dates against non-collegiate or junior-college opponents; there are no score gaps.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Biola are the only programme without a goal: no scorer named across three matches, four conceded, and their one point came from a goalless draw at Colorado School of Mines.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made fifteen saves for Westmont at a save percentage of .789.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cole Friesen has scored once from ten shots for Point Loma.

last_match.line: UT Dallas had lost at Hawai'i Hilo earlier in the week; Hawai'i Pacific had won their previous home match.

next_match.line: Westmont have not won since Simon Fraser; Western Washington beat Point Loma earlier in the week.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
